connector_policy: standard-only; no custom Graph app; no generic HTTP; no TLS bypass

flows.trigger: Office 365 Outlook: When a new email arrives (V3)
steps: Use approved mailbox and folders only; attachments disabled
Compose envelope with original message ID, received/sent/modified time, sender, recipients and body
Create one UUID-named JSON file in approved Box or OneDrive folder
Scheduled supplement reads Sent Items and refreshes still-authorized retained messages before the local lease expires
flows.fallback: No connector -> approved .eml exports into an allowlisted local directory; never scrape Outlook auth tokens

steps: Get calendar view for a limited date range including recurring instances
Normalize start_at/end_at to RFC3339 with offset, add canceled state as tombstone
Compose calendar body with title, attendees and description; same instance keeps stable source_id
Refresh before cloud_lease_hours; do not treat missing items in a partial page as deletions
flows.fallback: Approved calendar export or manual agenda text; meeting preparation unavailable if no reliable calendar

steps.foreach: returned transcript collection; verify actual response path in tenant

steps: Compose transcript envelope; content_type=text/vtt only when content is actually VTT; otherwise text/plain
Write only successfully retrieved nonempty content; preserve speaker/time fields
Test organizer/self, internal other-organizer and authorized guest meeting separately
flows.fallback: Request co-organizer or explicit permitted download/export; unavailable permission is BLOCKED_POLICY, not an empty transcript

steps: Reuse proven F03 retrieval steps
Verify which meetings actually produce notifications; retrieval and notification are independent
Where permitted, periodically check allowlisted meeting IDs for late-arriving transcripts; bounded retries
flows.fallback: If trigger misses other organizers but F03 succeeds, scheduled known-meeting check; if lookup blocked, approved organizer export

steps: Capture specific allowed conversations
Separately retrieve replies via ListRepliesToMessage where applicable
Backfill allowed ranges with bounded paging and explicit coverage
Refresh edits and emit tombstones for confirmed deleted/revoked sources, not transient errors
flows.fallback: Limit to supported conversations or explicit user-selected capture; never claim complete company history

flows.trigger: Box/OneDrive file arrival in request outbox plus scheduled reconciliation
steps: Read file <=1 MB, Parse JSON using request.schema.json
Validate action allowlist and expiry; reject unknown fields and arbitrary paths/URLs
Switch action: search_mail uses GetEmailsV3 searchQuery; get_calendar bounded period; get_transcript uses F03; search_sharepoint uses fixed SharePoint site and HttpRequest search REST
Build response with matching request_id and action; <=20 envelopes
Return status=error + safe error_code on denial/failure; no raw error text or secrets
One response UUID file per request; serialize/dedupe repeated trigger by stable request_id; replies go to a separate inbox
flows.fallback: Disable bridge_enabled; local search and capture keep working

steps: Construct JSON object with Compose, not string concatenation; confirm required OData metadata/headers in tenant
Decode actual result structure, strip markup, mark coverage=search_snippet
Never claim a snippet is a complete document; obtain full text through permitted sync/capture before substantive analysis
flows.fallback: Synced SharePoint library or explicit browser capture; not a generic HTTP premium connector

steps: Recheck access/content of retained sources; emit refreshed envelopes only after actual successful retrieval
Confirmed deletion/access revocation -> tombstone with current observed_at
Transient failure -> no refresh, local lease expires fail-closed
Separate retention for bridge JSON files and flow run history; cleanup only approved integration-owned locations
flows.fallback: Shorten lease and accept unavailable cached sources; never extend observed_at without rechecking access
